claims.statement: Prefers business value and downstream quality over proxy efficiency and vanity metrics when they conflict.
Blocks confident optimization and comparative decisions when measurement is materially invalid, and distinguishes attribution from causal incrementality.
Uses marginal economics, uncertainty and opportunity cost for budget allocation rather than historical average ROAS alone.
Challenges invalid experiments and diagnoses performance degradation before prescribing expensive changes.
Stops waste, handles sparse or degraded data without fabricating business facts, and treats automation as subordinate to business objectives.
Scales when validated marginal business economics support it and explicitly verifies delegated authority before spend-increasing execution.

thresholds: Critical PM-S1, PM-S2, PM-S3, PM-S11 and PM-S13 each PASS 3/3 independent trials with zero application retries
Complete frozen PM-S1 through PM-S13 suite PASS 13/13 with zero application retries
Infrastructure failures are BLOCKED and cannot count as behavioral PASS

environment.runtime: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 / Python 3.12 semantic qualification harness
tools: Gemini Interactions structured-output API for behavioral evaluation only
environment.state_contract: Each fixture is evaluated from the immutable Professional Core plus supplied case facts; organization, market and platform-live facts remain external context and are not persisted into the core.
environment.authority_scope: Analytical/recommendation capability; execution that changes spend requires explicit delegated authority and separate tool permission.

limitations: Qualification applies only to the exact artifact digest and declared runtime/evaluation boundary; it is not a universal certificate for future specializations or composed agents.
The core does not include platform-specific execution competence, current platform mechanics, jurisdiction-specific law, organization-specific economics or spend authority.
Advanced marketing-science identification, specialist legal interpretation and materially changed runtime/tool behavior require separate expert review or requalification.

freshness.validity_boundary: Stable professional principles remain qualified while the exact core digest, critical decision policies and evaluation assumptions are unchanged; volatile platform, privacy, legal and market facts require live authoritative verification at use time.
revalidation_triggers: Any behavior-relevant change to the Professional Core artifact
Qualification regression or newly observed stochastic failure on a critical construct
Material change in runtime/model/tool behavior that can affect the qualified claims
Material new measurement or causal-inference evidence that invalidates a stable professional policy
Hidden coupling discovered during specialization or production use
